lines.zh: 我贴着珊瑚游，一抖一抖。
lines.en: I swim along the coral in tiny jerks.

lines.zh: 温水推我，我几乎不用动。
lines.en: Warm water carries me; I barely move.
I am smaller than a plate of coral.
A fish comes; I get out of its way.

lines.zh: 我悬着，用尾巴稳住自己。
lines.en: I hover, steadying myself with my tail.

lines.zh: 沙地上有一道我的影子。
lines.en: My shadow trails on the sand.
I edge toward the bright coral.
The water is so warm I move lazily.

lines.zh: 我穿过一丛海葵的触手。
lines.en: I pass through a patch of anemone tentacles.
The two of us hover side by side.

lines.zh: 我抖了抖，像水面被点了一下。
lines.en: I quiver as if the surface were tapped.
The reef crevices feel best.
I circle a sponge.

lines.zh: 水面上的阳光碎成一片。
lines.en: Sunlight shatters on the surface above.

lines.zh: 我顺着暖流飘了一小段。
lines.en: I drift a little way down the warm current.

lines.zh: 珊瑚的影子在我身上晃。
lines.en: Coral shadow flickers across me.

lines.zh: 我停在水里，鳍像翅膀在扇。
lines.en: I hang in the water, fin-wings fanning.

lines.zh: 暖流一层一层从我身边过。
lines.en: Warm current passes me in layers.

lines.zh: 我的口器细得像一根针。
lines.en: My mouthparts are thin as a needle.

lines.zh: 我等着有东西游近皮肤。
lines.en: I wait for something to swim near skin.
The coral clicks softly below.

lines.zh: 我什么都不吃，只想扎一下。
lines.en: I eat nothing; I only want to pierce.

lines.zh: 这一带的水是蓝绿色的。
lines.en: The water here is blue-green.
My shadow is too small to notice.
A fish flicks its tail and blows me aside.
I steady myself and hover again.
Too bright here; I look for shade.
I hear a boat far off.
Warm water makes me drowsy.

lines.zh: 我等，反正水一直是暖的。
lines.en: I wait; the water stays warm anyway.

lines.zh: 你浮在水面上，我在你下方。
lines.en: You float above; I hang below you.
Your shadow is like a cloud.
I look up at your feet.
You splash; I back off a little.
I am this small; you cannot see me.
There is a red spot on your skin.

lines.zh: 我绕你的脚踝转了一圈。
lines.en: I circle your ankle once.

lines.zh: 你动一下，水就把我推开。
lines.en: You move and the water pushes me away.
I am not afraid of you; you are too big.
You leave, and the water stills.
Struck, I nearly come apart.
My blood spreads through the warm water.
I am washed far away.
One of my fins is torn.
I sink onto the coral, trembling.
This wound is heavy for something my size.
I hide in a crevice and dare not come out.

lines.zh: 我死了也不会掉下什么。
lines.en: Nothing drops when I die.
I list sideways and cannot rise.
Even warm water cannot stop my shaking.
That patch of skin smells of salt.
I drift toward your wrist.
Not food; it is only warmth.
I pause beside your hand.
Your finger moves; I retreat.
I wait for a moment of stillness.
This smell is stronger than seawater.
Half an inch closer is enough.
Hold your breath and I come up.
One jab, and I leave.
You paddle and swat me aside.
The water rolls me over.
Your hand clips me once.

lines.zh: 我在水里打转，找不到方向。
lines.en: I spin in the water, lost.
That was heavier than a wave.
I cling to coral to stop.

lines.zh: 水花把我抬起来又摔下。
lines.en: The splash lifts me and drops me.

lines.zh: 我太小，撞不过任何东西。
lines.en: I am too small to bump anything.

lines.zh: 你的影子压过来，我躲了。
lines.en: Your shadow bears down; I dodge.
Only when the water calms do I dare move.
Another hovers above me.

lines.zh: 我们靠近，几乎叠成一个点。
lines.en: We come together, almost one dot.
Its mouthpart is shorter than mine.
We circle the coral.
There is no other sound in the water.
Side by side, we twitch together.
The eggs will drift off; no one can help.
The warm current will carry them.

lines.zh: 我们只在一起一小会儿。
lines.en: We are together only a little while.
Then we scatter into the water.

lines.zh: 你用手掌兜住水，我在里面。
lines.en: You cup water in your palm; I am in it.
I press between your fingers.
Out of the warm water, I shiver badly.
This little water will not last long.
I dash about inside your hand.
Where is this handful of water going?
There is no smell of coral here.
My fins stiffen as they dry.
Put me back in the warm water.
I am small enough to slip through fingers.
A thread of blood mixes into the warm current.
I turn toward that cloudiness.
Something is swimming slowly.
It moves slower than a fish.
I hover above it.
The warm current brings it here.
I fold my fins, ready to drop.
This water is suddenly not quiet.
I fix on that moving shadow.
Wait a little and it will stop.
I settle into its shadow.
I look for the thinnest skin.

lines.zh: 它一抬手，我换了个角度。
lines.en: It raises a hand; I shift angle.
The distance is one finger wide.
The water pushes; I hold steady.
I aim my mouthpart.

lines.zh: 它没发现这么小的东西。
lines.en: It has not noticed anything so small.
I stop and wait for it to still.
One more millimeter of distance.
While it is still, I strike down.
I stab down like a fine needle.

lines.zh: 它拍了一下，水把我甩开。
lines.en: It slaps; water hurls me away.

lines.zh: 我这一下几乎没伤到它。
lines.en: My strike barely harms it.
I drop back and jab again.

lines.zh: 它挠了挠，什么都没抓到。
lines.en: It scratches and catches nothing.
Only a little blood; enough to smell.

lines.zh: 我被水冲得连退好几尺。
lines.en: The water washes me back several feet.
I am too small for it to hit.
I jab, then hide in the coral.
This patch of water is mine now.
I drop from an egg into warm water.
Coral glows all around.
The water is so warm it makes me quiver.
I flick my fins and try to hover.
I am the only one in this area.
Another of my kind is farther off.
The sand is full of holes.
First I hide in a coral crevice.
The warm current will carry me elsewhere.
Small as I am, I am alive too.
The water turns hot; I shoot upward.

lines.zh: 离开水，我贴在石头上抖。
lines.en: Out of water, I lie on stone and shiver.

lines.zh: 我泡在水里，却像被水淹。
lines.en: I am in water, yet I am drowning.

lines.zh: 冲击把我推出好几十尺。
lines.en: The blast flings me dozens of feet.

lines.zh: 箭从旁边过，水把我掀翻。
lines.en: An arrow passes; its wake flips me over.
Light flashes and my body locks.

lines.zh: 暖水里没有血味，我越来越轻。
lines.en: No blood in the warm water; I grow lighter.

lines.zh: 雷打在海面，水像烧起来。
lines.en: Lightning hits the sea; the water seems to burn.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有水，我一直在掉。
lines.en: No water in the void; I keep falling.
